Watch a preview of our exclusive interview with David A Steinberg, Co-Founder and CEO of Zeta Global(NYSE: ZETA)

Zeta Global has been built like layers of dreams - just like #Inception - with each chapter requiring the company to reinvent itself.

We started in 2017, at the #pivotal board meeting where Zeta decided to transform from a customer lifecycle platform into an AI-native company, sunsetting its previous platform and redefining the future of marketing innovation.

Fast forward to 2026, we explored another major #evolution - the biggest pivot in the company’s history - with the launch of #Athena, an AI voice-enabled conversational super agent that moves beyond keyboards and platform navigation toward managing outcomes.

We also unpacked Zeta’s M&A #strategy: after completing 19 acquisitions in 19 years, what does their post-merger integration (#PMI) playbook look like?

And Lastly, in a marketing world dominated by Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), but what's about #Agent Driven Acquisition Costs?

And can you guess David’s favorite #movie? 🚀🪐⏳

# AI Summit: Sanaz Yashar, Co-Founder and CEO at Zafran Security

播放

Watch our exclusive interview with Sanaz Yashar, Co-Founder and CEO at Zafran Security.

Born in Iran, moved to Israel, studied #Biology and ended up in Cyber. There’s never a dull moment with Sanaz!

Join us as Sanaz walks us through her incredible journey, building Zafran Security . It all started with a #cyber incident at a hospital —an event that pushed them to think differently and develop a way to quickly identify and reduce real threats without relying solely on #patching.

Sounds simple? Well, not when you’re dealing with 30 million #vulnerabilities. It’s all about the order—just like making #PersianRice. As Sanaz says: you only add the Zafran at the end. That’s why we even got a live #demo! (of their cyber product)

We also discussed Zafran Security’s #GTM approach, how they initially engage with #clients, and explored real-world cases where they’ve made a major #impact.

So how are Biology, Cyber, Persian rice, and #StephCurry all connected? 🧬💻🍚🏀
